title: Yomi, the Thousand Hells
summary: The hell-realm of the Yama Kings.

claims.text: Yomi, the Thousand Hells, is the home of the Yama Kings, each waiting for a chance to be crowned Demon Emperor, and the realm where the wicked dead suffer without end.
Every Kuei-jin has passed through Yomi before the Second Breath returned them to the world.

title: Mahanaga Visparakni
summary: Held to be the first akuma.

claims.text: Mahanaga Visparakni, said to be the first akuma, was claimed at once by the Yama Queen Tou Mu and has suffered at that demon's hands ever since.
As corruption spread, the Wan Xian fought one another for little empires instead of guarding the Middle Kingdom, draining whole villages of Chi, and the August Personage of Jade grew angry.

title: Pika Don
summary: The Yama King asleep since the atomic bombs.

claims.text: Right after the atomic blasts that ended World War II, the Yama King Pika Don went into the Yin World, meaning to gather the tainted Chi for a war against Emma-o.
After drinking only a little of it, Pika Don fell into a nightmare-ridden slumber that has lasted to this night, which unsettles the other Yama Kings.

title: Lanka
summary: A sleeping hell around Ravana's palace.

claims.text: Lanka lies dormant except for the grounds around its temple and the palace of Ravana.
Those who slip past the rakshas and come near say the palace is being rebuilt, or is growing, with rakshas and captured souls labouring on it.

title: Mikaboshi's Wicked City
summary: An endless hell of urban blight.

claims.text: Mikaboshi's Wicked City is an urban wasteland running to every horizon under choking smog and acid sleet, its streets crowded with souls slaving at hopeless labour.

title: Failed Akuma Supplicants
summary: What becomes of Kuei-jin the Yama Kings reject.

claims.text: Many Kuei-jin who seek a Yama King's favour and fail are overwhelmed by the P'o and perish, or spend eternity in jade collars as guards and hunting beasts of their court.
Others turn to the Devil-Tiger Dharma, either finding a road to enlightenment or falling to the Black Iron Talon sect; some become lesser akuma and scrape by on what little pay they get.
